description: Header file for the Map Controller Channel Selection module, defining functions related to channel and bandwidth control for wireless radios, including initialization, updating, and dumping of controller state.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_set
methods.description: Sets controller preferences and sends a channel selection request with specified radio, channels, bandwidth, and ACS settings.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_set_channel
methods.description: Sets the channel for the specified radio.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_set_bandwidth
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth for the specified radio.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_update
methods.description: Updates controller preferences without sending a channel selection request, used when control channels are updated.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_dump
methods.description: Dumps the current controller channel selection state for debugging or logging.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_init
methods.description: Initializes the channel selection controller module.

methods.name: map_ctrl_chan_sel_fini
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources used by the channel selection controller module.
